valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027 underlying RC EPS per ADS viewed at the Nov 2027 target date). Cyclical producer, so mid-cycle judgement. ADR: 1 ADS = 6 ordinary shares; BP reports per-ADS figures in USD, so no FX conversion needed (dividend $0.0866 per share x 6 = $0.5196 per ADS). Anchor: underlying RC profit per ADS $2.22 in Q2 and $3.26 in Q3 2026 (Q3 inflated by refining margins and trading; Q1 not sourced). FY2027 EPS and multiples are our stated assumptions, not a sourced forecast.

bear.driver: Oil and refining margins normalize sharply from the Q3 2026 crisis-level; earnings fall back toward the $0.85 per ADS of Q3 2025 run-rate in part.

base.driver: Margins ease from Q3 but remain above 2025; net debt target already met at $13.9B supports distributions; strategy update on 15 December.

bull.driver: Elevated prices persist and cost and balance sheet gains lift buybacks, supporting a higher multiple.

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS of $6.20 the close of $45.70 implies 7.4x; the broker mean of roughly $46 to $47 (aggregator, July 2026) implies about 7.5x on the same EPS.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $6.20 (13.6% of the close); $1.00 of EPS at 7.5x moves it by $7.50.
valuation.watch_metric: Realized refining margin and upstream price versus Q3 2026, and the buyback and capital allocation framework in the 15 December strategy update.
valuation.next_disclosure: Strategy and outlook update on 15 December 2026; Q4 and FY2026 results expected early February 2027 (date not confirmed).

analyst_notes: Named, dated calls found are few and all have undisclosed horizons, so none enter the weighted target. Piper Sandler Neutral $47 (Mar), TD Cowen Hold $41 (Jul), HSBC Hold (Mar) and Freedom Finance Sell $37 (Feb) bracket the close, which is near our base case. Most are stale relative to the Q3 2026 beat, and aggregator figures (Raymond James $52, Mizuho $51, Evercore In-Line $38) lacked verified dates and are excluded.
